purpose: Teach: ミート/ヘブライ/ボリシェヴィキ/ストリーミング/非対称/自滅/習熟/人力

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、加工ミート事業を強化しろ
lines.style: Clipped, decisive opening. Authority without theatrics. Each phrase lands flat and final. Speaking to action, not debate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ヘブライ語圏への翻訳事業も検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll explore translation services for Hebrew-speaking markets.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment. Slight pause before the pivot to the next point. Professional, attentive—taking notes mentally. No enthusiasm, just competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ボリシェヴィキ的な急進改革は避けろ
lines.en: Avoid radical overhauls in this company. We don't operate that way.
lines.style: Steady, warning tone without harshness. A slight lean forward on 'avoid'—not harsh, but non-negotiable. Clear on principle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内動画のストリーミング配信を活用します
lines.en: Understood. We'll leverage our internal video streaming platform.
lines.style: Respectful recalibration. Acknowledges the correction and pivots smoothly. Slightly faster pace—demonstrating he's already thinking ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、非対称な戦略で大手に対抗しろ
lines.en: We need asymmetrical strategies to compete with larger players.
lines.style: Quiet emphasis on 'asymmetrical'—this is the key word. Measured pace. Speaking from experience, not hypothesis. Settling back slightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。自滅的な値下げ競争は致しません
lines.en: Understood. We won't engage in self-defeating price wars.
lines.style: Firm agreement. Quick and decisive—this is a principle he already understands. No hesitation, just confirmation of aligned thinking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の習熟を支援する研修を増やせ
lines.en: Increase training programs that help our staff develop real mastery.
lines.style: Shift to warmth here—still commanding, but with investment in the people. Slightly slower on 'mastery.' This matters to him.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。災害時には人力サポート体制も整えます
lines.en: Understood. We'll also prepare manual support systems for emergencies.
lines.style: Final confirmation with a note of thoroughness. Steady, slightly heavier—showing he's absorbed everything. No rush to leave.
